name: shuriken-radial-menu
intent: Four-point hub rotates open into N/E/S/W sectors at 0/90/180/270° and radius 3.6rem.

reducedMotion.behaviour: All four sectors appear open immediately; no rotation

acceptance: Exactly 4 sectors open to sectorDeg [0,90,180,270] at radiusRem 3.6
Sectors stagger by staggerMs 40 (N→E→S→W) within openMs 280
Selecting a sector commits that label; replay closes then reopens
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows all sectors open immediately
